component_parameters.title: Component parameters
component_parameters.description: Configure which component and configuration to run, along with the target Keboola stack.

#sapi_token.title: KBC Storage API token
#sapi_token.description: Limited Access SAPI Token with restricted access to the component you wish to run in the project you wish to run it in.

keboola_stack.title: KBC Stack
keboola_stack.description: Select the Keboola stack where the target component configuration exists. Choose 'Custom Stack' for private or single-tenant deployments.

custom_stack.title: Custom Stack
custom_stack.description: The name of your stack in connection.{CUSTOM_STACK}.keboola.cloud

component_id.title: Component ID
component_id.description: Select the component you want to run. Click 'Re-load components' to fetch available components from the selected stack using your SAPI token.

config_id.title: Configuration ID
config_id.description: Select the configuration to run. Click 'Re-load configurations' after selecting a component to fetch its available configurations.

run_parameters.title: Run parameters
run_parameters.description: Configure how the component job should be executed and whether to use variables.

wait_until_finish.title: Wait until finish
wait_until_finish.description: If checked, the Component Runner will wait for the triggered job to complete before finishing. This is useful when you need to ensure the job succeeded before continuing in a flow.

use_variables.title: Use variables
use_variables.description: Enable this to pass variables to the component run. Variables can be defined manually below or loaded from an input table.

variable_mode.title: Variable mode
variable_mode.description: Choose how variables are provided: manually defined in this configuration, or loaded from an input table (where column names are variable names and each row triggers a separate run).

enum_titles: Variables Defined by Input Table - run all
Variables Defined by Input Table - run only first row

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: Define the variables to pass to the component run. Each variable needs a name (matching the variable name in the target configuration) and a value.

name.title: Variable Name
name.description: The exact name of the variable as defined in the target component configuration.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value to assign to this variable for the component run.
